mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM ainer_identity_access_event WHERE publication_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND available_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY available_at, occurred_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE ainer_identity_access_event event SET lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = event.attempt_count + 1 FROM candidates WHERE event.id = candidates.id RETURNING event.id, event.event_type, event.tenant_id, event.subject_id, event.payload_version, event.occurred_at, event.publication_status, event.attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_identity_access_event SET publication_status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{eventId} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND publication_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
